Downtown San Jose.name: Downtown San Jose
Downtown San Jose.description: High-rise residential and office core around Diridon and the Google transit village, with the densest permit pipeline in the metro.

SoFA District.name: SoFA District
SoFA District.description: South-of-First arts and nightlife district turning former industrial blocks into mixed-use and creative-office conversions.

Japantown.name: Japantown
Japantown.description: Historic low-rise commercial enclave with renovation-heavy permitting and strict preservation overlays.

North San Jose.name: North San Jose
North San Jose.description: Cisco-era office sprawl being rezoned to high-density residential and life-science lab space along the BART alignment.

Berryessa.name: Berryessa
Berryessa.description: BART-adjacent infill suburb with townhome and multifamily replacement of aging auto-oriented retail.

Alviso.name: Alviso
Alviso.description: Bayland-edge former township with sparse, flood-prone development and teardown-rebuild pressure near the salt ponds.

Almaden Valley.name: Almaden Valley
Almaden Valley.description: Hill-county estate and large-lot residential stock at the south valley floor, dominated by high-value renovation permits.

Cambrian Park.name: Cambrian Park
Cambrian Park.description: Post-war bungalow and cottage-grid neighborhood with renovation-led permits and independent retail spines.

Blossom Valley.name: Blossom Valley
Blossom Valley.description: Mid-century residential flatlands south of Almaden Expressway with steady small-lot infill and ADU construction.

Evergreen.name: Evergreen
Evergreen.description: East-foothill residential community with new-construction permits and hillside teardown-rebuild activity.

Eastridge.name: Eastridge
Eastridge.description: Mall-adjacent commercial node transitioning to mixed-use residential under the Eastridge transit-oriented plan.

Willow Glen.name: Willow Glen
Willow Glen.description: Storybook-bungalow historic district on the west side with renovation-heavy permitting and strict tree ordinances.

West San Carlos.name: West San Carlos
West San Carlos.description: CalTrain-adjacent corridor undergoing station-area densification with multifamily replacements of aging retail.

Santa Clara Edge.name: Santa Clara Edge
Santa Clara Edge.description: Levi's Stadium / Mission College edge with mixed commercial and residential intensification spilling from Santa Clara.

Lawrence Station.name: Lawrence Station
Lawrence Station.description: Light-rail-adjacent office-to-residential conversion corridor on the San Jose/Santa Clara border.

Milpitas Edge.name: Milpitas Edge
Milpitas Edge.description: Northern metro boundary shading into Milpitas; BART/Berryessa-adjacent infill permitted through San Jose.
